normalization_rules.bairro_prefix_stripping: Strip leading municipal numeric ID prefix (e.g. '181 - JARDIM DAS NACOES' -> 'JARDIM DAS NACOES')
normalization_rules.empty_bairro_handling: Records with empty bairro mapped to 'DESCONHECIDO_SEM_BAIRRO' (1,252 records, largely unaddressed cadastral lots in sectors 1.6, 2.1, 4.4)
normalization_rules.alias_preservation: No unverified merging of similar names; 'VILA SANTA CRUZ SALADEIRO' and 'SANTA CRUZ DO SALADE' preserved as distinct cadastral entities per raw records.
normalization_rules.address_parsing: Standard municipal format 'STREET_NAME, TYPE, NUMBER'. Lote/Gleba references marked as non-street-addressed.

classification_thresholds_pre_registered.DENSE_DSQ_AVAILABLE: contains at least one DSQ with >= 15 unique DSQLLL

human_context_comparison.observation: Human approximate counts were generally close to raw record counts (e.g., Jardim das Nações 642 vs 642, Jardim Bela Vista 213 vs 213, Vila Marli 115 vs 115, Bosque Flamboyant 114 vs 114, Cidade Jardim 82 vs 82, Chácaras Reunidas Brasil 61 vs 61, Jardim Mourisco 48 vs 48, Vila Santa Cruz Saladeiro 41 vs 41, Vila Nossa Senhora das Graças 153 vs 153). However, qualitative coverage reclassification reveals that Bosque Flamboyant only contains 2 streets in the corpus (classified as LOW_COVERAGE despite 114 records), Vila Nossa Senhora das Graças has only 40 street-addressed records (classified as MEDIUM_COVERAGE), while Cidade Jardim satisfies all HIGH_COVERAGE criteria.
